issue.classification: Confirmed source-contract incompatibility; no T2 GREEN/runtime reproduction
issue.cause: T1 content_sha256 is a complete TaskContract commitment, but T2 creates its immutable original_time before any planner contract exists. Later adoption constructs a contract containing later UTC timestamps. Keeping original_time unchanged cannot satisfy an earlier commitment to those unknown bytes.
evidence: original observation raw_tools.codec_read (1d7b67), test_helper_read_stored_wrapper (162529), original_schema_read (86f4fc); both actual native patches retained
Frozen writer snapshots original_time before capture/planning, then requires both publication and bootstrap to retain it and the existing local.v1 tags.
not_claimed: No measured permission bypass or failed T2 GREEN
Two foundation draft patch groups are incomplete parent implementation, not accepted behavior
No ability to predict future contract hashes

compatibility: Keep all 15 existing outer tags, OUTER_FIELDS six keys, original_time schema visual.local-original-time.v1 and nine keys, all existing payload top-level field sets and four-key history entries unchanged.

LOCAL_APP_PRODUCED and EXTERNAL_UTC retain their exact original two-key provenance and complete-contract hash rules. Existing legacy v1/v2 serializers, UTC-veto getters, external UTC validation and prior T1 fixtures/goldens are not migrated, relabelled or rewritten.

This plan explicitly extends only provenance kind dispatch for a previously unsupported staged local bootstrap. It does not reinterpret any old kind, infer a version from diagnostics, or make a malformed old record valid.

bootstrap_original_provenance.content_sha256: Use the existing strict canonical _hash of {schema_version:'visual.local-bootstrap-source.v1',definition:<exact validated bootstrap definition payload>}. The definition payload is exactly the existing nine FIELDS entries: scope,episode_id,user_instruction,task_timeout_s,verification_limits,role_bundle_hash,model_snapshot_hash,source_hashes.
bootstrap_original_provenance.acyclic: Hash the definition payload, not its envelope/original_time/provenance/decision/transaction. Its real role/model/source/policy and episode are available before the task is opened. No placeholder/future contract hash.
bootstrap_original_provenance.issuance: Only the existing exact registered local worker/startup/app owner and real private bootstrap initialization may originate this kind. The task origin, original acquisition, hard references, source identity and initial allowances are issued once by existing original D machinery. Capturing, retry, adoption, heartbeat and restart never reissue them.
bootstrap_original_provenance.validation: Decode original_time with its existing strict reference/source/domain/fence rules plus this explicit new kind. At every bootstrap definition boundary recompute the exact definition commitment and compare source_hashes. All nested bootstrap records and requests retain identical original_time.

adopted_payload_provenance.content_sha256: Existing canonical _hash of the complete actual adopted TaskContract JSON, including its real timestamp/issued_at/valid_until bytes; do not zero, predict or replace these fields.
adopted_payload_provenance.bootstrap_record: The complete exact local bootstrap record captured before the promotion operation under the real publication locks, including original definition, actual capture/plan history, spent budget, real decision and transaction evidence. Never the post-promotion record.
adopted_payload_provenance.no_cycle: Before recursively decoding the embedded record, enforce exact bootstrap record shape, terminal_reason=null, adopted_original_hash=null, pending=null, planning_source_usable=true, observation and draft present, budget unexhausted, and history requests exclusively bootstrap.transition.local.v1 (no promotion). Decode/replay it fully, not shape-only. No cyclic/self embedding, strings instead of records, or caller-provided opaque hashes.
required_joins: Enclosing original_time must be byte-for-byte JSON-equal to embedded record/definition/history originals and use LOCAL_BOOTSTRAP_SOURCE_V1; adopted kind cannot pair with either old kind.

Recompute the embedded definition commitment using bootstrap_original_provenance and compare immutable content_sha256; source inventories, episode/identity/lease/fence, role and model source all remain joined.

Validate complete existing definition-derived history replay, deterministic claims, revision/CAS/pre-post links, all prior decisions/transactions, budget debits and original references. Reject incomplete/UNKNOWN authorization on the live producer; detached history never grants live authority.

Validate actual adopted contract against the real saved draft using existing _proposal_projection and only existing bootstrap compiler substitutions (task identity/version/command and declared target aliases). Preserve existing exact nested keys/defaults/type checks and full proposal hash.

Retain existing _bootstrap_promotion_source requirements/dependencies/camera/condition/compiler validation. Refactor its pure already-validated value checks if needed; do not call _audit_original/from_payload on the same original while validating its provenance, and do not create a fake UTC original to reuse legacy checks.

For promotion, embedded pre-record definition_hash and the existing canonical _history_state_hash must equal the request's definition_hash/expected_record_hash and the actual replay/live prestate. Do not compare a raw envelope digest where the existing CAS uses its canonical state projection.

The promotion history produces the existing adopted_original_hash from the actual original and existing resulting_record_hash/transaction chain; publication.original_plan_hash and complete contract_hash bind that original/contract. Never replace SQL history or use adoption success to grant replay permission.

contract.staged_dispatch: Only the new source kind uses the new adopted payload kind. _semantic(original), _semantic(promotion), _join_audit_original and promotion replay must call one consistent staged provenance validator. All other original/task/source/budget/hash checks remain. Route, supervision and owner-publication joins continue to require the exact same immutable original; descriptive nested data retains its existing separate-original allowance.
private_producer: The actual VisualWorkerRuntime local bootstrap creates the initial definition commitment, retaining genuine issuer registration and frozen D references.

At adoption, acquire the real job guard/transaction then event lock/transaction in the parent order, recheck both live D authorities, load the exact current complete planning record and perform actual revision/CAS. Compile the real existing draft under its bound source policy and capture actual pre-record provenance.

Commit through the existing parent pending/completion protocol with real receipts; keep original_time exactly unchanged for bootstrap, original, pools, publication, promotion and later semantic edges. One adoption/debit, no replay/refund/new origin. Same record can be detached history after restart, never a live session.

Only the internal registered local producer selects these kinds. External caller TaskContract objects retain EXTERNAL_UTC and its original deadlines. The producer cannot relabel an externally supplied contract as staged local merely because it is well formed.
Diagnostic UTC may remain in actual original external models; it is neither fabricated nor used to extend local D. Local .lease/.task_started_at/.effective_deadline_at UTC-veto behavior stays intact.
implementation_constraints: No new outer field, public privilege boolean, permissive Any/type-ignore route, blanket exception acceptance or bypass of strict JSON/canonical hashing.
The embedded pre-record is archival evidence, not an issuer; a valid decoder result alone never authorizes a writer.

Do not silently let a source-kind local original pass the old full-contract hash test by skipping it: require both a separately recomputed actual contract hash and the complete source/prestate/compiler chain.
Preserve the already-saved three draft file modifications; complete the existing T2 implementation rather than reverting accepted historical originals or treating drafts as tested.
